threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still take out a map to find your way around Dalston’s backstreets; locals navigate by the sound of buzzing barbecues and pop-up shops.
Saw a guy on the 333 last night trying to barter with the driver for a free ride. Apparently, a half-eaten pasty was his best offer.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The smell of freshly baked Baklava wafting from the corner shop during a midnight stroll. You just don’t get that vibe anywhere else.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you grab vegan currywurst after a night out, with locals discussing art projects at 3 AM in the street. Pure Berlin magic.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they pull out an umbrella at the first hint of fog—most just squint and keep walking.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a girl in flip-flops sprinting after the Muni, yelling about her morning coffee. Classic SF hustle, even when the dog on the tracks delays it.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about parks and plazas, but they miss the real magic in the quiet side streets, where the old bakeries tell stories.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell newcomers by the way they insist on paying with cash at cafes. Everyone else swipes a card without a second thought.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think Buses run on time. That blank look when you suggest a Tube is an option? Classic rookie mistake.
Last night on the 3 bus, a bloke serenaded the whole upper deck with 90s R&B. Everyone pretended to ignore it, but we were totally vibing.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a family having a picnic on the street during the bus strike, kids playing while the adults sipped coffee on the curb. That’s Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a 'knick-knack' shop selling vintage postcards and random collectibles tucked behind an old club. It's like a treasure hunt!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a true local when they casually complain about the never-ending BART delays but still find a way to make it to their favorite taco truck.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 19 today just as a guy in a tiger onesie boarded, holding a saxophone. Only in the Tenderloin could that pass as typical.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every street performer is a local artist, but many are just passing through for tips, especially around the plaça.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still checking their phones for the next metro instead of just following the crowd to the nearest station.
